data.assumption: I interpreted “July” as July 2026 and “across all countries” as one total count of non-test payment attempts globally.
data.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM payment_attempts pa
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = pa.order_id
WHERE pa.is_test = FALSE
  AND o.is_test = FALSE
  AND pa.business_date >= DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND pa.business_date < DATE '2026-08-01'
